title: Partition of a Binary String
statement: The task is to partition the positions of a binary string (n up to 5000) into sets where any two members with different characters must be adjacent, maximizing the sum of set size times distinct characters, and count optimal partitions mod 998244353. Mixed sets are adjacent pairs or 'aba' triples, so alternating runs are tiled by blocks of 2 and 3, and isolated leftovers are counted with Bell numbers.
